topic: Area of Study 1: Instrumental Music of Haydn, Mozart and Beethoven
subject: music

moments.title: Haydn at Esterhazy
moments.body: Haydn takes a court post that will last 30 years, with an in-house orchestra to experiment with daily.
moments.takeaway: Court patronage funded sustained creative experiment.

moments.title: London symphonies
moments.body: Haydn composes 12 symphonies for Salomon's London concerts, including the 'Surprise', 'Military' and 'London'.
moments.takeaway: The market replaced the court for the late Classical symphony.

moments.title: Creation premiered
moments.body: Haydn's oratorio depicts the world's creation, including a famously dissonant 'Chaos' opening.
moments.takeaway: Religious music could be cosmically curious.

now.title: Haydn today
now.body: Haydn's 104 symphonies are increasingly recorded as complete cycles. His string quartets remain pedagogical core.
now.open_questions: How do we listen to a composer with such a vast catalogue?

reflection: Haydn invented the symphony as we know it, one piece at a time.
